title: Whole Solder Station and Twin Probe Meter Preparation Bench
description: One static electronic-repair equipment preparation bench, one scene and zero new independent models. A complete original open worktable supports the entire corded-iron solder station on its left and the whole recessed blank-dial meter with both original probe leads on its right. The soldering iron remains in its original inclined coil rest and the meter probes stay in their original parked arrangement; neither is detached or connected to another object. A complete original ring-footrest stool stands independently in front, separated from the full table envelope. The empty central tabletop gap and forward floor retain visible separation. This is a normal equipment preparation workstation, not the existing computer-and-printer demonstration or raised two-level mechanical metrology station; no printer, computer, workpiece or raised metrology plinth is supplied. All four whole old models preserve original local buffers, normals, hierarchy, unit scale and complete PBR. Only whole translations and one finite scene-only floor are new. The existing pink stool is not recoloured or certified as operator seating. Static visual only: no electronics repair, circuit connection, soldering heat, electrical test, instrument reading, seated ergonomics, installation, load or safety is claimed. Rigging animation interaction not made.
